topic: BYOVD Windows kernel driver vuln hunting / LLM-assisted assessment template

decompile.device_on_load_path (验证维度: IoCreateDevice调用路径决定是否需要物理硬件)

methodology_equivalent.4_gate_exploitability: device可打开(\\DosDevices\Name无条件存在) + 具体IOCTL定位 + 危险操作值源自IOCTL输入缓冲 + 无硬件/PnP前置 => 对应 hack-team finding确认协议

methodology_equivalent.structured_poc_json: device/ioctl/method/input_fields/primitive/confirms_if => 对应 verification_path 供 hack-exploit 直接使用

deploy_gating: 完整引擎需 Ghidra(analyzeHeadless)+JDK+Vertex AI凭据+驱动语料, 本机openjdk仅11(需≥17), Python3.14; 落地拆后续卡, 本卡只收方法论文档资产
